target_backgrounds: Senior backend engineers (L5/IC4+) from ML infrastructure or platform teams
Staff engineers who built distributed systems for model serving or inference
Backend engineers from real-time data processing or streaming platforms
Infrastructure engineers who worked on API gateways or high-throughput services at AI/ML companies
Platform engineers from developer tools or observability companies with distributed systems experience
Senior backend engineers from fintech or adtech with low-latency system design experience
target_companies: Cloud infrastructure companies (AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI teams)
High-frequency trading firms with low-latency systems
Streaming data platforms like Confluent or real-time analytics companies
Developer infrastructure startups focused on ML/AI tooling
candidate_search_strategy.seniority: Senior to Staff level (5-10 years experience). Strong preference for candidates at Senior Engineer (IC4/L5) with 5-7 years who have demonstrated ownership of critical distributed systems and comfort with architectural decisions in ambiguous, early-stage environments. Staff-level candidates (IC5/L6) with 8+ years also appropriate if they're excited about hands-on building at Series A stage.

boolean_query: ("Senior Engineer" OR "Staff Engineer" OR "Senior Software Engineer" OR "Backend Engineer" OR "Infrastructure Engineer" OR "Platform Engineer") AND (Python OR Go OR Golang) AND ("distributed systems" OR "model serving" OR inference OR "ML infrastructure" OR "AI infrastructure" OR Kafka OR gRPC OR "low latency" OR "high throughput" OR "real-time systems") AND (OpenAI OR Anthropic OR Replicate OR Modal OR Anyscale OR Databricks OR "Hugging Face" OR "Scale AI" OR Confluent OR "HFT" OR "high frequency trading" OR fintech OR adtech OR observability)
